## Rule

Input is color one-hot [1,10,30,30]. A cell containing `3` that is **orthogonally
adjacent to a `2`** becomes `8`; a cell containing `2` orthogonally adjacent to a
`3` becomes `0` (background). 5s and isolated (non-adjacent) 2s/3s are unchanged.
Output is one-hot [1,10,30,30].

### Don't-do
- Don't build dense/split Conv or any multi-op neighbor detector: charged [1,C,30,30] intermediates dominate (79k+).
- Don't reduce the shift eigen-rank of `spatial_basis` below 10 — fails visible.
- Don't Slice/crop the input to shed the 200 zero-pad params — charges a ≥4000-byte intermediate.
- Don't use `sparse_initializer` or `Constant(sparse_value)` to not-count the zero-pad — grader-dead (None) / memory-charged (1492).
- Don't dtype-narrow initializers for cost — `params` is element count, dtype-independent (saves 0).
- Don't try a rank<3 base — threshold-identity over 10 colors needs 3 slots (sign-rank>2).

## Algorithm sketch

```
m2, m3 = input[:,2], input[:,3]                         # one-hot masks
N2, N3 = cross_neighbor_sum(m2), cross_neighbor_sum(m3) # orthogonal 4-neighbours
out8 = m3 * (N2>0);  out3 = m3 * (N2==0)
out2 = m2 * (N3==0); out0 += m2 * (N3>0)                # deleted 2s -> background
# all other channels (1,4,5,6,7,9) pass through unchanged
```
Live implements this as a free-output DFT-shift bilinear Einsum (memory 0).
